topics.title: Switch
topics.description: Study concepts and solve targeted engineering problems for Switch.

pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code when the input is 3?

```go
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    var binary int
    fmt.Scan(&binary)

    switch binary {
    case 0:
        fmt.Println("Zero")
    case 1:
        fmt.Println("One")
    default:
        fmt.Println("Not valid")
    }
}
```
